findings.label: blocking
findings.text: No per-user lock: a message still inside the AI call when APAGAR is confirmed re-saves her full file, and a new key is created.
findings.response: Fixed: per-uid lock around _handle. Regression test fails with the lock removed (checked).

findings.label: blocking
findings.text: With a pending delete, a voice note 'não, não quero apagar não' contains APAGAR and deletes everything.
findings.response: Fixed: says_apagar/confirms_delete require apagar to lead the sentence and reject any NAO.

findings.label: blocking
findings.text: If MASTER_KEY changes, load crashes before APAGAR (she can never delete) and sweep skips the file forever.
findings.response: Fixed: store.Unreadable; APAGAR deletes without decrypting, otherwise she is told to send APAGAR; sweep falls back to file age.

findings.label: blocking
findings.text: After MUDAR every message is parsed as a mode choice: APAGAR is swallowed, and substring matching ('ler' in 'mulher') drops real reports.
findings.response: Fixed: keywords and messages over 8 words leave the step; whole-word/stem matching.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Consent refusal voice note recreates her key file and folder after delete.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Legacy users never expire; legacy plaintext media silently drops out of the resumo.
findings.response: Fixed: expiry by file age when last_seen is missing; plaintext media encrypted on first read.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Voice reply files pile up forever.
findings.response: Fixed: sweep clears resposta_* after an hour.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Twilio cleanup queue read-modify-write races across threads.

findings.label: question
findings.text: A first-contact voice note goes to ElevenLabs STT before consent.
findings.response: Kept on purpose (needed to understand a spoken answer); PR text now discloses it.

findings.label: question
findings.text: Tracebacks can carry her words in exception messages.
findings.response: Fixed: scrubbed_tb keeps frames and exception type only.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: A SALVAR intent injected via a forwarded screenshot silently extends retention to a year.
findings.response: Pushback: non-destructive, the reply states it, APAGAR undoes it; a confirm adds friction to the command that protects her evidence. Reviewer accepted.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Legacy plaintext media with an unreadable key raises out of read_media (500 / resumo crash).
findings.response: Fixed: inside the try; test added.

findings.label: suggestion
findings.text: Cleanup queue is emptied before processing; a restart mid-loop loses SIDs.
findings.response: Fixed: file rewritten only at the end; test added.

findings.label: suggestion

findings.label: question
findings.text: The lock is per process; multiple workers bring the race back.
findings.response: Added to the go-live checklist: one worker, one instance, until a file/DB lock exists.

findings.response: Accepted as is: the data is unreadable anyway.
